verses.text: This is a message from the LORD. It is against the land of Hadrach, and it will come to rest on Damascus. For the eyes of all people and of all the tribes of Israel are on the LORD.
It is also against Hamath, which borders on it, and against Tyre and Sidon, even though they are very wise.
Tyre has built herself a fortress. She has piled up silver like dust and gold like mud in the streets.
But the Lord will take away her possessions and throw her power into the sea, and she will be burned up by fire.
Ashkelon will see it and be afraid. Gaza will twist in pain, and so will Ekron, because her hopes will be crushed. Gaza will lose her king, and Ashkelon will be left empty.
Foreigners will live in Ashdod, and I will put an end to the pride of the Philistines.
I will take the blood out of their mouths and the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become like a clan in Judah. Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
I will guard my house against armies that march back and forth. No oppressor will ever again overrun my people, because now I am watching over them with my own eyes.

Celebrate with all your heart, people of Zion! Shout for joy, people of Jerusalem! Look, your King is coming to you. He is righteous and brings salvation. He is humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the young of a donkey.

I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the war horses from Jerusalem. The bows used in battle will be broken. He will announce peace to the nations. His rule will stretch from sea to sea and from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will set your prisoners free from the dry pit.
Return to your fortress, you prisoners who still have hope! Today I announce that I will give you back twice as much as you lost.
I will bend Judah like my bow and load it with Ephraim like an arrow. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and make you like a warrior's sword.
Then the LORD will appear over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet and march out in the storms of the south.

The LORD of Armies will protect them. They will destroy their enemies and trample down the stones from their slings. They will drink and shout as if drunk with wine. They will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.
On that day the LORD their God will save his people, as a shepherd saves his flock. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.
How good and how beautiful they will be! Grain will make the young men strong, and new wine will make the young women thrive.
